title: Gift of Halloween Horror
body:
"The gift shrieks with pumpkin delight, as you feel a deep rumble!"

The Gift of Halloween Horror is a gift obtainable from the Monstrous Manor. It costs 75,000 Candy to purchase and is found on the second floor of the Mansion. Opening the gift reveals a Pumpkin Carriage.

Details

The Gift of Halloween Horror will soon be unobtainable as the event ends.
